patronOf.en-US: Patron of the sick and of nurses
patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro dos enfermos e dos enfermeiros

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Serving you in our neighbor, we may, at the hour of our death, pass safely over to you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Servindo a vós em nossos irmãos, possamos partir confiantes ao vosso encontro na hora da nossa morte.

meta.face: A man of about fifty-five with a long, rectangular face and a heavy, square jaw — a large, long nose, broad at the bridge, deep-set, slightly hooded grey-brown eyes under thick, straight dark brows, lines running from the nose to the corners of a wide, firm mouth, lean cheeks; close-cropped dark hair greying and receding from a high forehead, a short, clipped dark beard and moustache flecked with grey, and a compassionate, weathered look down at the sick man.
meta.basis: The painted portraits and early engravings agree on close-cropped receding hair, a short beard or stubble and a long, strong face with a large nose; his biographers record his great height. He founded the Ministers of the Sick in his thirties and died at sixty-four.
